objective: Steal bounded mechanics from six video games without importing their fiction, branded skin, economies or authority model.

transfers.rule: failed attempts must change the next encounter or stop
useful residue may aid later actors without synchronous shared state
predictable effects should be visible before authoritative commit
support may succeed by removing itself after capability transfer

authority: No donor grants FIELD new mutation authority. RUMOR is read-only and resolves existing manifest routes.
falsifier: Delete RUMOR if it behaves like a quest/backlog, manufactures urgency, or duplicates route reading without improving re-entry.
next: Do not add more game-derived UI until a current FIELD friction names a missing function.
